repository_summary: The README for Aspose-PDF-FOSS-for-Go describes a pure-Go library for PDF creation, editing, conversion, and validation. It supports PDF 1.7/2.0, Markdown/PDF conversion, HTML/SVG export, AI copilots, and has no external dependencies. The library is MIT-licensed and requires Go 1.24+.
